payload_schema_ref.description: Repo-relative path to the JSON schema for this category's payload.

mandate_scope.description: The CallContext.scope_text for a state-sync call on this category, hashed into scope_fingerprint and checked against the mandate envelope's scope_fingerprint (ADR-032; see agent-platform/cortxt_mcp/mandate.py CallContext and verify_mandate). This is NOT an allowed_tools entry: tool-level gating is a separate check against the envelope's allowed_tools list, which must contain the actual MCP tool names (state_read, state_write, state_delete, state_since), not this dotted category string.
